untrusted_code_execution.note: Prior plugin source was inspected statically only.

known_limits: The implementation is a prototype stdio MCP server, not a formal MCP conformance-suite certification.
HTTP transport and OAuth are intentionally not implemented; external-source security requirements are recorded for a future remote transport.
The fixed internal operation registry covers the reusable behavior classes observed in the plugins but does not attempt byte-for-byte emulation of every prior plugin.
